lines.en: Zoe, how was your first night on stage? You looked pale before the curtain went up.
lines.pt: Zoe, como foi sua primeira noite no palco? Você estava pálida antes de a cortina subir.

lines.en: Honestly, I had never felt so nervous in my life. My hands were shaking, and my mouth was completely dry.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, eu nunca tinha me sentido tão nervosa na vida. Minhas mãos tremiam, e minha boca estava totalmente seca.

lines.en: But you had rehearsed for months. I had never seen anyone prepare so carefully.
lines.pt: Mas você tinha ensaiado por meses. Eu nunca tinha visto ninguém se preparar com tanto cuidado.

lines.en: That is what scared me. I had never stood in front of such a big audience, and I had never been so afraid of forgetting my lines.
lines.pt: Foi isso que me assustou. Eu nunca tinha ficado diante de um público tão grande, nem tido tanto medo de esquecer as falas.

lines.en: Did you forget them? From the third row, everything seemed perfect.
lines.pt: Você esqueceu? Da terceira fila, tudo parecia perfeito.

lines.en: Only one line. I had never experienced such a long silence, but my partner covered for me with a quick look.
lines.pt: Só uma fala. Eu nunca tinha vivido um silêncio tão longo, mas meu parceiro me cobriu com um olhar rápido.

lines.en: That is what a good partner does. After the show, you were so relieved that you hugged the whole cast.
lines.pt: É isso que um bom parceiro faz. Depois do espetáculo, você ficou tão aliviada que abraçou o elenco inteiro.

lines.en: I was so relieved! I had never been so happy and so tired at the same time.
lines.pt: Eu estava tão aliviada! Nunca tinha estado tão feliz e tão cansada ao mesmo tempo.

lines.en: What did the director say? As far as I knew, he had never praised a beginner so openly before.
lines.pt: O que o diretor disse? Até onde eu sabia, ele nunca tinha elogiado um iniciante de forma tão aberta.

lines.en: He said I had handled the pressure better than anyone he had worked with, which made me blush.
lines.pt: Ele disse que eu tinha lidado com a pressão melhor do que qualquer pessoa com quem trabalhou, e isso me fez corar.

lines.en: You earned it. Tomorrow you will not be so nervous, and the applause will be even louder.
lines.pt: Você mereceu. Amanhã você não vai estar tão nervosa, e os aplausos serão ainda maiores.

facts.label: Sentimentos extremos
facts.sub: Algo nunca vivido antes do momento passado: I had never felt so nervous. Com substantivo: such a big audience. Consequência: so… that.

facts.label: Nunca tinha
facts.sub: Use had never + particípio para dizer que algo era uma experiência nova num momento do passado: I had never felt so nervous. Never fica entre had e o particípio, sem inversão.

facts.label: Tão
facts.sub: Use so antes de adjetivo ou advérbio (so nervous, so carefully) e such antes de substantivo (such a big audience). Ambos intensificam o sentimento. Não misture: nunca diga such nervous.

facts.label: Tão… que
facts.sub: Use so + adjetivo + that para mostrar a consequência: I was so relieved that I hugged everyone. Esse molde dá força à história e conecta a emoção com o que aconteceu.

facts.label: Vocabulário
facts.sub: Troque nervous por termos mais fortes: terrified, overjoyed, exhausted, relieved. Exemplo: I had never been so relieved. Escolha uma emoção específica e use did/had com cuidado.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Had never felt so nervous gives emphasis.
We say “I never had felt so nervous”.
items.why: We say I had never felt.

items.s: So goes before an adjective, such before a noun.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Had never felt so nervous gives emphasis. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I never had felt so nervous”. → Falso (We say I had never felt.)
So goes before an adjective, such before a noun. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: Had never + participle is used for the future.
items.why: It looks back from a past moment.

pages.title: The night of the curtain · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday night in a small theatre in Auckland. The lights go down. Zoe stands behind the curtain with a paper in her hand. It is her first show in front of real people. The next day, her friend Abby meets her at a café. Abby wants to know how it felt.

“Zoe, how was your first night on stage? You looked pale before the curtain went up.” says Abby. “Honestly, I had never felt so nervous in my life. My hands were shaking, and my mouth was completely dry.” says Zoe. “But you had rehearsed for months. I had never seen anyone prepare so carefully.” says Abby.

items.target: Only one line. I had never experienced such a long silence, but my partner covered for me with a quick look.

items.cue: Eu estava tão aliviada! Nunca tinha estado tão feliz e tão cansada ao mesmo tempo.
items.target: I was so relieved! I had never been so happy and so tired at the same time.
